origin: Atlas simulated leadership review, founder reports dual broker and auctioneer qualifications

identity.dual_qualification: Texas real estate broker and auctioneer (founder-reported; verify current licenses before public copy)

vision: Make competitive real estate sales in Central Texas easier to understand and more trustworthy.
mission: Help property owners compare their choices and execute a suitable real estate sales strategy with transparent terms and accountable professional guidance.
brandPromise: A clearer way to sell. Real options. Honest guidance. Competition when it makes sense.

hero.headline: Your property. Your options. A clearer way to sell.
hero.body: Explore a traditional listing, an as-is sale, or a structured competitive strategy with a team that explains the trade-offs before you choose.
hero.disclaimer: A competitive sale is one option, not a promise of a higher price.

seller.label: Explore selling options
seller.initialQuestion: What matters most to you about your next move?
seller.nextStep: A staff member explains the paths and confirms your goals before proposing a sale strategy.

buyer.label: Ask about a property
buyer.initialQuestion: Which property are you interested in?
buyer.nextStep: A staff member explains the applicable property, offer and bidding terms; no price or offer is treated as verified from a public form.

promiseChecks: No invented bidders, price guarantees or manufactured urgency.
No consumer record access without verified staff authorization.
No IWCO lead transfer to Rivet without an appropriate, permissioned process.
No public bidding, payment or highest-offer feed before a documented protocol is approved.

faqs.q: Will my home have to go to auction?
faqs.a: No. We review the options first. A competitive sale only makes sense when the property, buyer demand and your goals support it.
Yes. We'll discuss condition, expected costs, timing, offers and possible selling paths before you commit.

faqs.q: Does competition guarantee a higher sales price?
faqs.a: No. Competition may help price discovery, but no specific outcome is guaranteed.

faqs.q: What if I decide not to sell?
faqs.a: That can be the right decision. Starting a conversation does not obligate you to sell.

faqs.q: How are auction terms and buyer premiums handled?
faqs.a: Any auction requires written and disclosed terms, including reserve and buyer premium where applicable, before you participate.
